I want to tell the story of a Jedi who is good, but doesn't know how good she is—and doesn't know why she's been chosen for this, and struggles with that question and what that would mean to her character.|Cavan Scott|<ref name="Gizmodo">{{WebCite|url=https://io9.gizmodo.com/how-marvels-star-wars-the-high-republic-comic-will-sho-1845625336|text=How Marvel's ''Star Wars: The High Republic'' Comic Will Show New Sides of the Jedi|author=James Whitbrook|date=2020-11-11|archivedate=20220622135106}}</ref>}}
'''''Star Wars: The High Republic''''', alternatively styled '''''Star Wars: The High Republic Phase I''''', is a [[canon]] comic book series written by [[Cavan Scott]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]] as part of Phase 1 of the [[Star Wars: The High Republic|multimedia project]] by the same title.<ref name="The High Republic" /> The comic series' [[The High Republic (2021) 1|first issue]] was published on [[January 6]], [[2021]].<ref name="Solicits" /> The series concluded a little over a year later with its [[The High Republic (2021) 15|fifteenth issue]] on [[March 2]], [[2022]].<ref name="Issue 15" />
